request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Mailcoat Deserter".

Creative brief
Name: Mailcoat Deserter
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A durable foot soldier that advances behind repeated spear-wave volleys.
Body and silhouette: Medium-height soldier with a rounded helmet, chainmail coat, small shield, and short throwing spear.
Signature features: Torn former-regiment tabard, dented helmet, and bundled javelins.
Palette and materials: Dull steel, desaturated blue, dusty brown, and faded white.
Movement personality: Trained, steady, and grimly practical.
Attack concept: Throws three javelins in parallel lanes, walks forward during the gap, and repeats with the lanes offset.
Directional details: The old tabard is torn away over the lower-left side.
Avoid: Heroic knight, pristine royal armor, spear projectiles without visible spacing.
